premise: Every agent IS a primal. Not 17 Rust binaries + models. The models ARE primals.

gen0.name: Base Alpacas
gen0.note: Raw weights. No organism awareness. Fossilized as base layer.

gen1.name: Gaia Primals
gen1.note: Custom system prompts. Know they're Gaia.

gen2.name: Organism-Aware + Niche
gen2.note: Know body, myths, weather. Niche roles.

gen3.name: Polaris Merge — The Cortex
merge_protocol: 2. Polaris runs arena on its 47 models with organism prompts
3. Winners get Gaia system prompts → new gaia-cortex-* models
4. Push back via git → eastGate absorbs Modelfiles
5. eastGate reprints from Modelfiles (or pulls if Polaris has ollama registry)

agent_as_primal.architecture: Each .pi agent IS a primal in the mesh

components.model: ollama model binding (pull from local or Polaris)

lifecycle.birth: sourDough prints Modelfile → ollama create → bearDog key derive
lifecycle.evolve: Arena selects → culture accumulates → new system prompt → reprint
lifecycle.fossilize: Old gen system prompt archived → model renamed to -fossil suffix
lifecycle.death: ollama rm + bearDog key revoke (only if replaced by better gen)

agent_as_primal.note: Each pi-gen agent can be cast from the template. 'cast' = print from Modelfile + generate .pi + derive key + register socket.

total_vision.eastGate: 20 models + 6 Gaia evolved + 2 new capabilities (vision, embed)
total_vision.northGate: 47 models + 7 arena-tested + cortex customs → Gen 3 merge
total_vision.sporeGate: tinyllama messenger relay → gossip across houses
total_vision.combined: 67+ unique models → arena selects → best become Gaia primals
total_vision.endgame: Every model IS a primal. Every primal can think. The organism IS the fleet.
